CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content was found.

COD.rationale: Content identification (red coordinates), an organization/pattern (the listed coordinates), and an origin/status field are all explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change statement tied to an identified content's organization/presentation/access was present.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content assignments (red/blue coordinates) are listed for current and candidate records.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate, inherited_current) separately attribute status/source to the identified contents.

O.rationale: The report explicitly states axis orientation and lists the organized coordinate pattern for contents, describing presentation/organization.
